evidence.title: MediSkill-Evo: Process-Constrained Self-Evolution for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Interaction

summary: Researchers introduce MediSkill-Evo, a self-evolving AI system designed to improve clinical decision-making by grounding interactions in evidence-based processes. The framework aims to refine medical AI applications through iterative, constraint-driven learning.
title: MediSkill-Evo: New AI Framework Enhances Evidence-Based Clinical Interactions
